findings.text: Eight bit circular shifts move every input bit to a rotated position with the distance taken modulo the width, offering complementary left and right forms that are pure and preserve bit population.
Thirty two and sixty four bit sign extension views a caller selected position as the sign source and replicates that logical level through all higher positions to form a correctly signed wider value.

Word size aware ordering support maps a nonzero count to the index needed for power of two sizing by inspecting the predecessor value, yields a negative sentinel for empty input, and selects the appropriate width specific scan at translation time.

Small word inspection helpers report odd parity of a byte through folding plus table selection, locate the lowest set bit in a sixty four bit value with special handling when the native word is narrower, and skip a requested number of set bits before reporting the next set position or the word width when none remains.

Bit assignment and typed pointer checked helpers conditionally assert or release a numbered bit and validate that the supplied address indeed points to an object before forwarding to the underlying word oriented set clear and test operations.

Atomic field modification helpers replace a masked region with new content or clear selected bits only when guard bits stay absent, retrying the underlying compare exchange until it succeeds and exposing the previously observed value for concurrency detection.
Each examined header declares a unique once only inclusion marker so repeated textual inclusion collapses to a single effective declaration set.
Fundamental width facts establish eight bits in every byte, derive the width of any type from its storage size, and decompose a logical bit number into an extended word index plus an intra word mask.

Mask construction facts create contiguous ranges of asserted bits between inclusive bounds within an explicitly named integer type and singletons at one position, with dedicated forms for eight sixteen thirty two sixty four and one hundred twenty eight bit integers plus a generic extended form that also has an internal helper based spelling.

Range builders carry translation time assertions that the lower bound never exceeds the upper bound and that a singleton offset always lies strictly inside the destination width, converting misuse into a build failure.

Ordered array search accepts a sought key plus base address plus element count plus element footprint plus caller ordering routine, repeatedly probes the middle of the remaining span and narrows toward the match, yielding the address of an equal element or an absent marker when the span exhausts.

Tree header organization keeps a reference to the current root node together with a reference to an allocation pool and a numeric height, while the wide key specialization and the generic template both embed that generic header as their initial member.

Wide key tree adapters present lifecycle plus lookup plus predecessor plus insertion plus in place modification plus removal plus extremal retrieval plus merging for composite pairs of sixty four bit halves, translating each pair into the generic key array form expected by the shared engine with its dedicated wide geometry.

Reusable tree templating derives concrete head types and operation names from a configurable suffix through token pasting and supplies matching single word and indirect key variants for the full operation family, instantiated for machine word and fixed thirty two and sixty four bit keys with associated bit widths geometries and key types.

Backward traversal macros establish that enumeration begins at the greatest stored key and advances through strictly decreasing predecessors until no entry remains, allowing the current entry to be safely revisited or reclaimed before the next step.

Tree visitation support invokes a caller supplied element routine with an opaque cookie across stored entries and reports how many were seen, offering a destructive form that tolerates reclamation during the walk and typed callback aliases for narrow and wide keys.

Ownership transfer helpers declare named automatic release actions for scope exit, capture and replace a tracked pointer with a caller chosen empty value in one step, and provide checked forms that hand the taken pointer to the caller or discard it without release.

Scoped resource abstraction lets authors declare a value type together with construction and destruction logic plus conditional extensions that may skip destruction, declare automatically cleaned locals, acquire named guards, and execute a body inside a loop scope keyed by a fresh label.

Masked replacement and guarded clearing perform an initial single observation followed by repeated compare exchange attempts that recompute the desired successor from the latest observation, aborting early when a forbidden test bit appears and thereby serializing concurrent writers without sleeping locks.

Guarded scope execution progresses from construction and acquisition through a lock presence test into either body execution with automatic release on exit or a failure path that runs caller supplied handling, distinguishing unconditional holders that always enter from conditional holders that may decline.

Lock guard storage pairs a reference to the protected object with optional author defined extra fields, provides pointer based and placeholder based construction paths with matching destructor driven release, and exposes attribute hooks for custom declaration decoration.

Range and portability hazards include shift distances that wrap rather than saturate, sign indices outside the value width that create extreme shift counts, empty counts signaled by a negative result rather than zero, first set scans that only understand thirty two and sixty four bit words, and mask requests that must satisfy bound ordering and width containment.

Guard introspection normalizes failure encodings by mapping error pointers to absent locks and by translating missing or raw status values into busy or zero outcomes, with a dedicated predicate that recognizes the reserved error number band.
